thread:
anya: FYI customer Mira reported repeated 504/502s from the /v1/rerank endpoint during a load test this morning, p95 latency spiking from ~350ms to ~3.2s under sustained concurrency. request ids: req_0a3f2b, req_0a3f7c, req_0a3fab. stack trace + sample payload below. Mira says it started after yesterday's runtime tweak. :frowning:

mira: Hey team — we ran a canary that sends 120 concurrent rerank requests, each with ~64 candidates (avg token length ~180). We see gateway timeouts and a lot of retries from our side. Repro steps attached.

ops-bot: [ALERT] rerank-service p95 latency > 2s for 6m; 504 gateway-timeout rate increased by 18% in us-west-2.

kevin: @luke @sam can you confirm if any deploys or config changes rolled out to rerank-runtime around 05:20 UTC? Logs show large queueing and some worker restarts.

luke: I rolled a kernel optimization at 05:12 but it was behind a feature flag and only enabled for a small pool. No planned timeout changes. I do see increased `batch_builder` queue length and `kv_cache` misses. Pasting a quick log snippet: 
```
[05:24:11] batch_builder: enqueued=120 in_flight=32 avg_wait_ms=78
[05:24:11] runtime: decode_ms=12 attention_ms=34 kv_cache_miss=0.43
[05:24:12] http_gateway: upstream_timeout while proxying to rerank-worker req=req_0a3f2b
```

sam: Hmm looks like the gateway saw long front-door queueing which then triggered upstream timeouts (504). Are clients retrying aggressively? If retries coincide with a load bump that could push batch sizes and latency up.

mira: Our client SDK retries with exponential backoff but we saw bursts of concurrent retries during the spike. We don't do idempotency keys for rerank (it's read-only).

anya: Customer-facing: Mira, sorry about the disruption. We're investigating. Can you paste the exact curl and headers you used? Also roughly how often each test runs?

mira: curl:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query":"summarize...","candidates":[...64 items...]}'
```
We spawn 120 parallel processes each sending ~10 reqs/sec for 5m.

kevin: Thanks. Two hypotheses: 1) large candidate lists + long token lengths push per-request compute time up, making continuous batching back up; 2) client retry bursts amplify a transient backlog into a sustained overload and gateway timeouts. We should confirm whether the edge timeout (LB -> gateway) is shorter than worker timeout causing 504 vs 502.

luke: Confirmed: our nginx upstream_read_timeout is 6s, worker-side request timeout is 12s. That mismatch can produce 504s at the gateway even though worker may still be processing. We should either raise the edge timeout or make the worker respond faster / shed load.

sam: Quick mitigations: (a) temporarily raise upstream_read_timeout to 15s for rerank route in us-west-2, (b) enable per-request circuit-breaker and limit concurrent in-flight rerank requests per IP/customer to 40, (c) put a short client-facing guidance note recommending fewer candidates or turning on client-side jitter/backoff.

kevin: I'll queue a controlled timeout bump for the route and add a canary to measure p95 impact. Also rolling out a small change to limit batch size to 48 candidates for the high-memory workers.

anya: MIRa — can you reduce parallelism to 40 for a quick test? If that stabilizes p95 for you we'll plan throttles on our side.

mira: Reducing to 40 concurrency now and will report in 2 minutes.

ops-bot: [METRIC] rerank-us-west-2 p95 latency: 3.12s -> 0.38s after 6m of throttling on our side.

mira: After reducing to 40 concurrency the 504s dropped to near zero and retries stopped. Looks much better. Thanks.

sam: Next actions: 1) kevin to bump the upstream timeout and monitor for 1h, 2) luke to roll batch-size cap and KV-cache warming to reduce per-request tail, 3) support to send customer guidance and follow up on SDK retry/backoff settings, 4) product to consider a soft quota for rerank candidate count per request.

kevin: Created ticket INF-9873 for timeout bump and throttle rollout, linking logs and req ids. Will monitor.

luke: I'll push a batch cap feature-flagged rollout to 10% first. If stable we increase. Commands I used to reproduce locally included this load generator snippet: 
```python
# gist: rapid-rerank-load.py
for _ in range(120):
    spawn_thread(send_rerank, candidates=64, qlen=180)
```
Add jitter on retries to avoid synchronized bursts.

anya: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with Mira in the next 24h with a postmortem and guidance. :thumbsup:

mira: Appreciate the quick help. Please keep me posted on quotas because we rely on rerank for ranking flows in production.

ops-bot: [CLOSE] incident INF-9873 prelim mitigated by upstream timeout bump and client throttling.
